node.title: Re: webperl - DOM manipulation and event example
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: In [https://youtu.be/bT17TCMbsdc|my talk on WebPerl] at around the 14 minute mark (slide 12 [https://goo.gl/QPvUb9|here]) I show how with WebPerl you can access the same APIs as in JavaScript. For a much more complex example, the [https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html|WebPerl Regex Tester] is written in (Web)Perl, see the source code [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/blob/gh-pages/regex.html|here].
